items.title: Then the summer weather returns: "Definitely warmer"
items.summary: Rain and debris have characterized the summer weather in parts of Sweden in recent days, and the coming week also looks set to begin with unsettled weather. During the day and evening on Sunday, a front moves north and parks over central Norrland. SMHI has issued a yellow warning for torrential rain in eastern Sveland and southernmost Gävleborg county and central Norrland.  - There will be a lot of rain and otherwise it is expected to be cloudy in large parts of the country, says TV4 Nyhetern's meteorologist Johan Tengholm.  Cloudy in most of Sweden During both Monday and Tuesday, the forecast shows temperatures of between 15 and 20 degrees in large parts of Götaland and Svealand and along the Norrland coast. Further up in the north it is a little cooler, and in the rain-affected areas the temperature can drop below 10 degrees. During Tuesday, it also looks like it will be cloudy in pretty much the whole of Sweden. - Here the temperatures look to be even cooler and it will not be more than 15-16 degrees in Götaland, Svealand and along the Norrland coast. In the northern hinterland it will be even cooler, says Johan Tengholm.  High pressure establishes itself But during late Wednesday and forward Thursday, a high pressure moves in from the southwest. This leads to higher temperatures in large parts of the country. Ahead of the weekend, the high summer heat looks set to make an entrance again. - The high pressure establishes itself in time for the weekend, and then it will be clearly warmer and stable summer weather. There may still be showers, but there will be temperatures of upwards of 26-27 degrees in southern Sweden and just over 20 along the entire Norrland coast. Even in the interior of Norrland it gets hot, says Johan Tengholm.
items.title_original: Då kommer sommarvädret tillbaka: ”Klart varmare”
items.summary_original: Regn och rusk har kännetecknat sommarvädret i delar av Sverige de senaste dagarna, och även den kommande veckan ser ut att inledas med ostadigt väder. Under dagen och kvällen på söndagen rör sig en front norrut och parkerar över mellersta Norrland. SMHI har utfärdat en gul varning för skyfallsliknande regn i östra Sveland och sydligaste Gävleborgs län samt mellersta Norrland.  – Det blir en hel del regn och väntas i övrigt vara molnigt i stora delar av landet, säger TV4 Nyheternas meteorolog Johan Tengholm.  Molnigt i i stort sett hela Sverige Under både måndag och tisdag visar prognosen temperaturer på mellan 15 och 20 grader i stora delar av Götaland och Svealand samt längs Norrlandskusten. Längre upp i norr är det lite svalare, och i de regndrabbade områdena kan temperaturen sjunka under 10 grader. Under tisdagen ser det dessutom ut att bli molnigt i i stort sett hela Sverige. – Här ser temperaturerna ut att bli ännu svalare och det blir inte mer än 15-16 grader i Götaland, Svealand och längs norrlandskusten. I det norrländska inlandet blir det ännu svalare, säger Johan Tengholm.  Högtryck etablerar sig  Men så under den sena onsdagen och framåt torsdag rör sig ett högtryck in från sydväst. Detta medför högre temperaturer i stora delar av landet. Framåt helgen ser högsommarvärmen ut att åter göra entré. – Högtrycket etablerar sig lagom till helgen, och då blir det klart varmare och stabilt sommarväder. Det kan fortfarande komma skurar, men det kommer blir temperaturer på uppåt 26-27 grader i södra Sverige och drygt 20 längs hela Norrlandskusten. Även i Norrlands inland blir det varmt, säger Johan Tengholm.

items.summary: The superstars have redeemed the football party on the other side of the Atlantic, but the question is whether it is not another figure who has advanced the positions the most: the World Cup in North America is well on its way to becoming the national team captain's renaissance.

items.title: Nichola came here as a 7-year-old - threatened with deportation
items.summary: Many Swedish-British in Sweden are still living in uncertainty after Brexit. 49-year-old Nichola Stanlick moved to Sweden as a 7-year-old. After Great Britain's withdrawal from the EU, she had to apply for a permanent right to live in Sweden again, but it was rejected.

items.summary_original: Många svensk-britter i Sverige lever ännu i osäkerhet efter Brexit. 49-åriga Nichola Stanlick flyttade till Sverige som 7-åring. Efter Storbritanniens utträde ur EU fick hon ansöka om att på nytt få permanent rätt att bo i Sverige, men det blev nej.

items.title: Poland procures three A26 submarines from Saab following talks with Swedish Government
items.summary: On 29 June, Swedish Prime Minister Ulf Kristersson visited Gdynia, Poland for government-level talks. The meeting focused on strengthened bilateral cooperation between Sweden and Poland in the areas of regional security and defence. Minister for Defence Pål Jonson, Minister for Foreign Affairs Maria Malmer Stenergard, Minister for Culture Parisa Liljestrand, Minister for Infrastructure and Housing Andreas Carlson and Minister for EU Affairs Jessica Rosencrantz also took part on the trip.

items.title: Sweden provides SEK 25 million to earthquake-stricken Venezuela
items.summary: The two earthquakes in Venezuela on 24 June have had a profound impact on the Venezuelan people and exacerbated an already difficult humanitarian situation. Sweden is now providing SEK 25 million in humanitarian assistance to Venezuela to support initiatives such as the distribution of food packages, access to clean water, temporary emergency shelter, protection of vulnerable groups and reunification of children and families who have been separated.

items.title: Offline card payments - now the possibilities are expanding
items.summary: As of today, July 1, 2026, expanded opportunities to pay by card offline will be introduced when purchasing essential goods. The measure strengthens the resilience of the payment system and is based on an agreement between the Riksbank and market participants.

items.summary_original: Från och med i dag, 1 juli 2026, införs utökade möjligheter att betala med kort offline vid köp av livsnödvändiga varor. Åtgärden stärker betalningssystemets motståndskraft och bygger på en överenskommelse mellan Riksbanken och marknadsaktörer.

items.title: Joint Declaration from the Polish-Swedish Intergovernmental Consultations Gdynia
items.summary: The Republic of Poland and the Kingdom of Sweden are close Baltic Sea neighbours, Allies and partners, tied together by shared history, geography and responsibility for their strategically important region. items.title: Sweden takes next major step towards new nuclear power
items.summary: The Government has decided that the state will become a shareholder in Videberg Kraft AB, which plans to build nuclear reactors at Ringhals. The Swedish state, Vattenfall AB and Industrikraft i Sverige AB have concluded a shareholders’ agreement on the management of the company. The state’s shareholding will be 60 per cent, while Vattenfall and Industrikraft will each hold 20 per cent. The state has also negotiated the principal terms and conditions for state aid to the company.

items.title: Sweden strengthens Ukraine’s energy supply ahead of winter
items.summary: Last winter, Ukraine’s electrical grid and power plants were intensively attacked by Russia. Ukraine must now make extensive efforts to ensure the energy supply for the coming winter. The Swedish Government has therefore approved a new support package for Ukraine worth approximately SEK 1.5 billion to support the country’s energy sector in 2026. It is expected to contribute to preparation through repairs, installation of new energy production, material support and enhanced nuclear safety.

items.title: Ulf Kristersson to hold joint press conference with Prime Minister of Poland on bilateral submarine cooperation
items.summary: On Monday 29 June, Prime Minister Ulf Kristersson will travel with several ministers to Gdynia, Poland for intergovernmental consultations. The focus will be on strengthened bilateral cooperation between Sweden and Poland, specifically with regard to regional security and defence. Mr Kristersson and Prime Minister of Poland Donald Tusk will hold a joint press conference during which they will announce a new development in the countries’ bilateral submarine cooperation.

items.title: Sweden joins special tribunal and international claims commission for Ukraine
items.summary: The Government has decided that Sweden will join the Special Tribunal for the Crime of Aggression against Ukraine and the International Claims Commission for Ukraine. Demanding accountability for Russia’s crimes against Ukraine is an important priority for the Swedish Government. The aim is to ensure redress and justice for Ukraine and its people.

items.title: Government receives state aid application for nuclear power project outside Malmö
items.summary: The Government has received another application for state aid to build new nuclear power reactors in Sweden. The application was submitted by Nordic Baseload Power for a project at Barsebäck in Kävlinge outside Malmö. This is the fourth such application received by the Government.
